hook: Did You Know the 'Cloud' is actually on Earth? 🤯
headline: The 'Cloud' Isn't in the Sky
source: Major Cloud Providers (e.g., Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure)

slides.speaker: camera
slides.title: Where is the Cloud? ☁️
slides.bubble: VJ, I thought the cloud was way up in the sky!

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: It's On The Ground! 🏢
slides.bubble: Nope! Your data lives in massive buildings called data centers.

slides.speaker: camera
slides.title: Digital Libraries! 📚
slides.bubble: So my photos are in giant computer rooms on Earth?

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: Share This Fact! 📢
slides.bubble: Exactly! Share this with anyone who uses the internet!

takeaway: When you save photos or stream movies to 'the cloud,' your data isn't floating in a mysterious digital ether. Instead, it's stored on countless powerful computers packed into massive, secure buildings called data centers.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know the 'Cloud' is actually on Earth? 🤯

💡 When you save photos or stream movies to 'the cloud,' your data isn't floating in a mysterious digital ether. Instead, it's stored on countless powerful computers packed into massive, secure buildings called data centers.
